title.narrative: Upgrading the Egyptian wood and furniture industry through holistic skills training and improved manufacturing capacities

description.narrative: The proposed project aims to contribute to increasing the domestic, regional and global competitiveness of Egypt#s wood and furniture sector and its ability to provide jobs. This will be achieved by deploying a Public Private Development Partnership (PPDP) approach through i) establishment of a Wood Center of Excellence, ii) operationalization of the Wood Center of Excellence through industry driven creation of curricula, hands-on trainer training, and upgrading of MSME workforce, and iii) enhancing employability of young Egyptians through skills training. The project builds on UNIDO#s experience in the design and implementation of Technical and Vocational Education and Training (TVET) projects including the wood and furniture sectors. The project is fully aligned with the Programme for Country Partnership (PCP) Egypt and its priority areas of value chain enhancement and investment promotion.
